bio.text: Anthony Hartsook, a Republican, has represented Colorado House District 44 since January 9, 2023.
According to Ballotpedia, Hartsook served in the U.S. Army from 1988 to 2015.

Ballotpedia also lists a B.S. in biology from Northern Arizona University (2001) and an M.S. in public administration from Central Michigan University (2007), and says his career included work as director of the Future Freedom Foundation and director of business development at Aspen Communications LLC.
